# Nabd 1.0.74 — the big update

### Textures
- Glowstone redrawn as glowing crystal clusters (hot centres, amber rims, real light).
- Granite, diorite and andesite: speckled stone with mineral grains; andesite with a soft sideways flow.
- Ice, packed ice and blue ice: calmer colour, light streaks, fine cracks and frozen plates.
- Deepslate redrawn: shaded lens-shaped slabs over a cool dark bed, with a matching top face; bedrock as a jumble of light and dark rock chips.
- Cobblestone, cobbled deepslate and gravel redrawn closer to the classic look.
- Third block refresh: netherrack, soul sand/soil, blackstone and basalt families, end stone, quartz family, amethyst, animated sculk, snow, stone bricks (all variants) and bricks.
- All ores redrawn with shimmer; diamond and emerald as a few big gems.
- Darker deepslate as slate plates; whole family matched.
- Cobblestone, mossy cobblestone, gravel, crying obsidian (glowing cracks), tall grass, suspicious sand and gravel.
- Badlands: natural sediment lines on all terracotta, sand and sandstone.

### Animations
- New: low health - hunched posture, heavier faster breathing and a limp.
- New: treading water - sculling arms and slow kicks when floating.
- New: elytra flight pose - arms swept back like wings, legs trailing.
- New: idle life - a look to each side now and then, and a big stretch.
- New: sword ready stance when standing with a sword.
- New: leaning into turns while running.
- Breathing while asleep.
- Rebuilt stateless: they now show on every recent game version.
- New: ladder and vine climbing, hit flinch, chewing while eating, panic arms when on fire.
- New attacks: axe overhead chop; pickaxe, shovel and hoe digging strike (first and third person).
- Polish: front arm swings inward, hips tilt on sidesteps, head counter-tilt, idle weight shift, breathing, steps when turning on the spot.
- Crouch eases in and the head no longer sinks; running jump without body lean.

### Other
- Night sight toggle with `/nabd:settings`.
- Better compatibility with add-ons that replace player animations.
